phases.title: Install required npm packages: bcryptjs, jsonwebtoken, uuid (and their @types) into src/benchmark-backend
phases.notes: Installed via pnpm --prefer-offline using versions from pnpm store: bcryptjs@3.0.3, jsonwebtoken@9.0.3, uuid@11.1.0, @types/bcryptjs@3.0.0 (deprecated stub, bcryptjs ships own types), @types/jsonwebtoken@9.0.10, @types/uuid@9.0.8. Private registry token was expired so used --prefer-offline to source from local pnpm store.

phases.title: Create database migration src/db/migrations/004_users.sql with the users table (id, email, username, password, created_at)
phases.notes: Created src/benchmark-backend/src/db/migrations/004_users.sql with the exact schema from the spec. Build passes cleanly; auth test failures are expected (routes not implemented yet).

phases.title: Create src/schemas/authSchema.ts with Zod schemas for register (email, username min-1, password min-8) and login (email, password)
phases.notes: Created src/benchmark-backend/src/schemas/authSchema.ts with registerSchema (email via z.string().email(), username min-1, password min-8) and loginSchema (email, password). Build passes cleanly. Test failures are all 404s because routes aren't wired yet — expected at this phase.

phases.title: Create src/services/authService.ts with register (hash password, insert user, return user+JWT), login (verify bcrypt, return user+JWT), and getById (lookup by userId from JWT payload)
phases.notes: Created src/benchmark-backend/src/services/authService.ts. register() hashes with bcrypt, inserts via uuid v4, maps UNIQUE constraint errors to 409 AppErrors. login() verifies with bcrypt, throws 401 AppError on mismatch. getById() does a simple SELECT. signToken() reads JWT_SECRET from env, signs {userId, email, username} with 24h expiry. Build passes cleanly. Auth tests still 404 (routes not wired yet — expected at this phase).

phases.title: Create src/middleware/requireJwt.ts that reads Authorization: Bearer <token>, verifies it with jsonwebtoken using JWT_SECRET, attaches decoded payload to req, and passes 401 to next() on failure
phases.notes: Created src/benchmark-backend/src/middleware/requireJwt.ts. Exports JwtPayload interface ({userId, email, username}) and augments Express.Request with jwtPayload?. requireJwt() reads Bearer token from Authorization header, calls jwt.verify() with JWT_SECRET (falls back to dev-secret), attaches decoded payload to req.jwtPayload, calls next(); passes 401 on missing/invalid/expired token. Build passes cleanly. All auth test failures remain 404 — expected since routes aren't registered until phase-7.

phases.title: Create src/controllers/authController.ts with register handler (201 + user+token), login handler (200 + user+token, 401 on bad creds), and me handler (200 + user object, no password field)
phases.notes: Created src/benchmark-backend/src/controllers/authController.ts. register() validates via registerSchema.safeParse() → ValidationError (400) on failure, calls authService.register() → 201 {user,token}. login() validates via loginSchema.safeParse() → 400 on failure, calls authService.login() → 200 {user,token}; 401 propagates from service via next(err). me() reads req.jwtPayload (set by requireJwt middleware), calls authService.getById() → 200 user object (no password field). All service errors forwarded via next(err) to errorHandler. Build passes cleanly. Auth tests still 404 — routes not mounted yet (phase-7).

phases.title: Create src/routes/authRoutes.ts wiring up POST /register, POST /login, GET /me, then mount authRoutes at /api/auth in src/app.ts
phases.notes: Created src/benchmark-backend/src/routes/authRoutes.ts with Router, wiring POST /register → register, POST /login → login, GET /me → requireJwt + me. Imported authRoutes in app.ts and mounted at /api/auth before the 404 catch-all. All 34 tests pass; build clean.

phases.title: Run pnpm test inside src/benchmark-backend and fix any failing tests in auth.test.ts
phases.notes: All 34 tests pass (2 test files). No fixes needed — prior phases left auth routes and services in a fully working state. Build also clean.
